item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q012_not_true_family_specific_pair","answer":"No—SCOPe 2.08 does not support treating d1s9za_ (Amyloidogenic design-1; protein SUNID 103785) and d1hqja_ (Unnamed design-1; protein SUNID 100906) as evolutionarily homologous.
